title: Coupled fixed-interface effect size of RM27 temporal endpoint difference

depends_on.RM26: temporal state discrepancy is surface-localized with zero column-storage difference in the diagnostic run
depends_on.RM27: same-horizon endpoints differ in q_swap(H) by about 3.47e-12 m/s over the F-GC44 bracket
depends_on.F-GC44: independent one-cell MODFLOW6 6.8.0 constant-flux endpoint oracle

purpose: Quantify, without accepting or rejecting, how the RM27 SWAP response difference propagates into the coupled SWAP-MODFLOW endpoint and integrated groundwater transfer.

frozen_inputs.one_cell_profile: exact F-GC44 closeout model and stopping-compatible solver settings

required_outputs: three MODFLOW oracle heads and fitted q_groundwater(H) slope/intercept
coupled root head for the one-step SWAP response
coupled root head for the two-half SWAP response
integrated groundwater-transfer shift over 8.64 s and 1 m2
transfer shift relative to the 3.6e-5 m3 surface irrigation pulse
transfer shift relative to the coupled groundwater transfer magnitude
failure_rule: Do not change RM27 response samples, MODFLOW topology, probes, area or window after execution. A MODFLOW oracle failure is technical; a large or small effect is scientific evidence but not an acceptance threshold.
nonclaims: RM28 does not define an application temporal tolerance.
RM28 does not admit the three-model triangle.
RM28 does not use F-GC44 nonlinear residual tolerance as an application-accuracy criterion.
RM28 does not qualify multi-window hydrological memory.
